allies.rationale_text: Active-listening gives emotional-intelligence a practical behavior for reading people without rushing past what they feel.
allies.source_quote: show the other person they are truly being listened to and understood
allies.affinity_rationale: Supports the social awareness component of EI by providing the receptive capacity to accurately read others' emotional states, though not named as a primary ally in the canonical Latticework.
allies.activation_condition: When social awareness requires attentive reception of emotional signals beyond the explicit content of what others are saying

allies.rationale_text: Empathy gives emotional-intelligence its strongest route into social awareness and accurate perspective-taking.
allies.affinity_rationale: Core competence within EI — canonical describes empathy as enabling effective use of analogies by 'invoking existing cognitive schemas' and helping communicators 'dodge the Curse of Knowledge by making abstract ideas concrete'.
allies.activation_condition: When understanding others' perspectives requires the ability to model their emotional states and knowledge gaps as a foundation for effective interaction

allies.rationale_text: Psychological-safety helps emotional-intelligence turn emotional candor into group trust instead of defensive silence.
allies.affinity_rationale: Supports the environment in which EI can be effectively applied — psychological safety enables the open emotional expression and vulnerability that EI skills are designed to navigate.
allies.activation_condition: When team dynamics require an environment where emotional expression is safe enough for EI skills like empathic concern and conflict navigation to function effectively

antagonists.rationale_text: Rationalization undermines emotional-intelligence by converting genuine emotional signals into self-serving narratives, corrupting the self-awareness and empathy loops that EI depends on.
antagonists.source_quote: People rarely use pure expected value calculations for major life decisions, instead relying on the Affect Heuristic (where feelings, rather than calculated values, drive assessment).
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Medium confidence — canonical points to cold rationality vs. emotional processing as the core tension. Rationalization as post-hoc justification can mask genuine emotional signals, but the canonical mechanism is different from the curation's mapping.
antagonists.activation_condition: When post-hoc rational justifications mask the genuine emotional signals that EI is designed to detect and respond to authentically

structured_tensions.tension_text: Emotional-intelligence conflicts with critical-thinking when emotional attunement to others' feelings substitutes for rigorous evaluation of the logical merit of their arguments.
structured_tensions.source_quote: emotional-intelligence conflicts with critical-thinking (critical thinking) when emotional attunement to others' feelings substitutes for rigorous evaluation of the logical merit of their arguments.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Emotional-intelligence conflicts with authenticity when skillful emotional management becomes performative regulation that obscures genuine reactions needed for honest engagement.
structured_tensions.source_quote: emotional-intelligence conflicts with authenticity (authenticity) when skillful emotional management becomes performative regulation that obscures genuine reactions needed for honest engagement.

curation_notes.summary: Layer 1+2 enrichment complete. Allies: empathy 0.90 (strong — core competence enabling social awareness), active-listening 0.80 (moderate — receptive capacity for emotional signals), psychological-safety 0.80 (moderate — enabling environment). Antagonist: rationalization 0.70 (supportive — medium confidence; canonical tension is cold rationality vs. emotional processing). Activation conditions assigned.
